# The URL gate's frozen list: docs/specs/02-cut-and-merge.md R9, read by tests/test_product_map_urls.py.
#
# Every URL name and path docs/PRODUCT_MAP.md listed at the start of Phase 2 (the map as of commit
# 38f4eab, unchanged at fd94517 when this list was taken), in the map's order, plus the pages the map
# names only in prose (marked "prose"; docs/specs/phase-2-code-map.md, AREA productmap). Taken before
# T13 rewrote the map, so every old link keeps being tested. Never remove an entry; when the map gains
# a URL, add it here (the test fails until you do).
#
# One entry per line, then its marks, then "# why" wherever the owner's answer is not a plain 200:
#   app:name                 a URL name; workspace_id is filled with workspace A when the pattern takes it
#   app:name?query           ... with the query string the map gives it
#   app:name kwarg=<object>  ... with another part filled from an object the test makes in workspace A:
#                            brief, job, conversation, token (a client's magic link), connection (a bot)
#   /path/                   a path as the map writes it; W/ stands for /workspace/<workspace id>/,
#                            <brief id> and the like for the same objects, and a trailing … is dropped
# Marks (a 301/302 to a page that answers 200 is always accepted and needs none):
#   405      the view takes POST only, so a GET answers 405 by design
#   403      refused to the owner by design
#   portal   needs a client's portal session: the owner is sent to the portal's sign-in page
#   skip     not a URL; listed so that every token of the map is accounted for

# Preamble
/workspace/<workspace id>/  skip  # the prefix every workspace page sits under, not a page of its own
app:name  skip  # the map's notation for a URL name

# Where things are on the screen: signing in, and the sidebar footer
/  # 302 to the person's landing page (Home for the owner)
accounts:settings  # prose: "your account", from the sidebar footer

# Home
studio:index
W/studio/
studio:create  405  # POST only: an idea typed on Home

# Set up
studio:setup
W/studio/setup/

# Routines
studio:routines  # 301 to Activity's routines section (D4); its POST handlers stay
W/studio/routines/  # the same 301

# Team; a job
studio:team  # the name moved to /studio/activity/ (D4)
W/studio/team/  # 301 to Activity (D4)
studio:job job_id=<job>
studio:team_board

# Settings hub and its pages
studio:settings_hub  # 301 to Settings, Brand tab (D5)
W/studio/settings/  # the same 301
studio:brand
studio:trust  # with the advanced_settings switch on, 301 to Settings, Advanced tab (D5, D6)
studio:memory  # with the advanced_settings switch on, 301 to Settings, Advanced tab (D5, D6)
studio:outcomes
studio:autopilot
telegram:settings

# A post
studio:detail brief_id=<brief>
W/studio/<brief id>/

# The team thread page
studio:thread
W/studio/thread/

# Approvals, the Calendar's list view
calendar:calendar?mode=list&tab=approvals
W/calendar/?mode=list&tab=approvals

# Calendar
calendar:calendar
W/calendar/
calendar:queue_list
calendar:posting_slots

# Inbox
inbox:feed
W/inbox/

# Blog & SEO
blog:list
W/blog/
blog:write

# Analytics
analytics:index  # 302 to the first connected account's analytics
W/analytics/  # the same 302

# Notifications
notifications:list
/notifications/
notifications:preferences  # prose: "under preferences"

# More
composer:create_landing
composer:drafts_list
composer:template_list  # prose: Templates
composer:category_list  # prose: Categories
composer:csv_upload  # prose: Import CSV
media_library:index

# Workspace settings
workspaces:settings  # 301 to Settings, Brand tab (D5)
workspaces:approvals_settings
client_portal_admin:client_list  # prose: Clients; 301 to Settings, Team & clients tab (D5)
social_accounts:list  # prose: Social accounts; 301 to Settings, Accounts tab (D5)
members:list  # prose: Members

# Telegram
W/agency/telegram/
/webhooks/telegram/<connection id>/  405  # Telegram's webhook ingress takes POST only

# Client portal
/portal/…  portal  # the portal's dashboard; 302 to its sign-in page without a portal session
client_portal:magic_link_entry token=<token>
client_portal:team  portal  # Talk to the team
client_portal:dashboard  portal  # prose: the dashboard
client_portal:approval_queue  portal  # prose: Approvals
client_portal:published  portal  # prose: Published
client_portal:activity  portal  # prose: Activity
client_portal:reports  portal  # prose: Reports
client_portal:telegram  portal  # prose: Telegram

# Older entry points that still work
studio:workflow  # 302 to Home
studio:workflow_create  405  # POST only
studio:workflow_resume conversation_id=<conversation>  405  # the map writes it without its namespace; POST only
studio:workflow_status  # the map writes it without its namespace

# How work flows
studio:thread_stop_brief conversation_id=<conversation> brief_id=<brief>  405  # prose: Stop on the brief card; POST only
studio:inbox_draft  405  # prose: Draft replies with the team; POST only
/routines  skip  # a Telegram command, not a URL
/mute  skip  # a Telegram command, not a URL
